title: Stone Solo #32 (석재 솔로 · malachite · 체형 amazon bombshell · 배경 검정 배경 · 극단 힐)

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — full body polished banded malachite fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Very low camera angle with the full length of every boot visible down to the floor, the towering heel height dominating the silhouette and lifting her far above the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
